tasks.label: Run TimeSheetApp
tasks.command: if [ ! -f ${workspaceFolder}/TimeSheetApp/node_modules/@sap/html5-repo-mock/index.js ] || [ ! -f ${workspaceFolder}/TimeSheetApp/node_modules/@sap/approuter/approuter.js ]; then npm i @sap/approuter && npm i @sap/html5-repo-mock; fi

tasks.label: Build TimeSheetApp
tasks.command: if [ ! -d ${workspaceFolder}/TimeSheetApp/timesheet/build ]; then npm run build-timesheet; fi
